layouts.name: IDrawingContext_DrawGeometry_VtableSlot
layouts.notes: The IDrawingContext-compatible subobject used by COcclusionContext and CDrawingContext exposes DrawGeometry at vtable slot 4. Both hook sites must share this typed slot descriptor.

layouts.name: IDrawingContext_GetDrawingContext
layouts.notes:
CDrawingContext::Create — IDrawingContext vtable at CDrawingContext + 16
Negative offset: IDrawingContext → CDrawingContext base = -16
Pre-2004: IDrawingContext was at +0 (absorbed into base vtable)
